name: Histogram
purpose: Single-series frequency distribution as contiguous column bins (no inter-bar gap) — e.g. transaction value distribution, response-time distribution. Semantic SVG in the DOM, styled by tokens, animated by CSS, behaviour by the ONE generated dv-behaviour partial (ADR-0015, worker fence — markers empty). CHART-EXPANSION WAVE 2 lane 1 (2026-08-05); ported from Chart-bar.reference.html's column geometry (canvas, axis mark contract, toolbar) with the bin-width arithmetic changed to close the inter-bar gap.

props.name: bins
props.$note: Contiguous value ranges; rect width == category slot width exactly (no bar-style inset), adjacent rects share an x-edge. DERIVED from Chart-bar's column geometry — see the snippet header for the exact arithmetic (8 bins, 522px plot area, 65.25px/bin).

props.name: data
props.$note: A real <table class="dv-table"> inside the figure — the a11y spine AND the tabular alternative (dv-005).

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state consumes the Empty-state pattern by reference.

variants.name: contiguous single-series
variants.use: Show the shape of a distribution across value bins. ONE colour (dv-014) — a histogram is not a categorical comparison, so bar's multi-hue categorical set does not apply.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class (DV-D08): .t-cm-chart-label / .t-cm-chart-value = 12/500 · table .t-cm-legal 12/400 · title .t-cm-section-label · static legend key text (new, see below) also .t-cm-chart-label
tokens.series: data/series/1 (column default per DV-D09 — reused unmodified; a histogram has no orientation choice to trigger the h-bar/series-3 branch); high-contrast remap data/series-1-hc (data-contrast="high")
tokens.axis: DECLARED GAP (ds-020, DIVVY-instructed): Chart-bar's DV-D07 two-channel axis/grid CSS role is NOT ported. The baseline carries colour via inline stroke="var(--baseline)" only, no gridlines drawn at all.
tokens.elevation: table popover + value tip = surface ground + elevation/functional shadow + elevation/border (anchored-overlay recipe, same as Chart-bar)
tokens.$survey: Bin geometry hand-derived from Chart-bar's column plotting math with the gap removed (rect width = slot width, not bar's ~44%-inset). Layer-2 machinery ported by REFERENCE, not yet injected — AUTO-BEHAVIOUR markers are empty (worker fence). NO dv-legend AUTO-BEHAVIOUR marker pair in this file (see accessibility.nonText — the legend is static, not interactive, so there is nothing for dv-legend.js to drive). #96-D3: adjacent bins now carry a 2px page-coloured stroke (rect.dv-series) — standing dataviz separation rule, same idiom as dv-004's donut/pie segment strokes.

motion.entry: Bins grow from the baseline (scaleY, transform-box:fill-box), 760ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), 32ms per-bin stagger (tighter than bar's 45ms — 8 contiguous bins read better with a faster sweep), CSS only (DEF-003).
motion.hover: brightness(1.12) light / (1.22) dark on the bin. Focus outline goes INSET (outline-offset:-2px) rather than bar's outside offset, because adjacent bins share an x-edge and an outside outline would visually bleed into the neighbour — a new, receipted delta from the bar contract.
motion.reducedMotion: Entry inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse present.

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, never scale text. data-pl="46" data-pr="12" — Chart-bar's own column margins, reused unmodified. data-fx/data-fw on rects (fw is a flat 0.125 for all 8 bins — an exact 1/8 of the 522px plot area, the contiguous-bin geometry's one simplification), data-fx on the baseline and bin labels.

mustNotNeighbour: A Stat-card making the identical claim in the same view
A grouped/stacked Bar chart in the same view — histogram's bins and bar's categories read as the same shape and are easy to conflate

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="group" with a full-sentence data aria-label reading every bin.
accessibility.name: The figcaption names the chart; each bin carries aria-label + data-tip naming its value range and count (popover value == table value, one source, once dv-behaviour is wired).
accessibility.keyboard: Bins are focus stops (tabindex 0 + aria-label → value popover on focus, once dv-behaviour is wired); table toggle = dropdown (aria-controls/expanded, Esc dismiss → refocus). No legend interaction — see nonText.
accessibility.focus: :focus-visible = 2px ink outline, INSET (outline-offset:-2px — see motion.hover for why).
accessibility.nonText: Series fill ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016). SINGLE-SERIES RULE (brief-instructed): the legend key is STATIC — a plain swatch + "Transactions" label marked aria-hidden="true", NOT the interactive DV-D11 filter/isolate chrome Chart-bar's multi-series legends use. There is exactly one series, so there is nothing to filter or isolate; the chart's own aria-label + figcaption already name the data, so the static key is a visual affordance only and correctly excluded from the a11y tree, not a redundant a11y gap.

antiPatterns: A gap between bins (dv-005-adjacent: a histogram's bins are a continuous domain — a gap misreads as a categorical bar chart)
Multiple series on one histogram (use small multiples or an overlay pattern instead — not this component)
Raw hex series fills (dv-017 — var() tokens only)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)
Scaling the whole SVG down responsively (DV-D02 — text must never scale)
